en:
It's a classic plot! There are even heroes 
who are lonely because they're too strong.
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Tsumugi for a while?

I'm holding out for a hero who can clean 
up this whole mess with one punch!

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi talked to me passionately
about her favorite hero...
<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi and I grew a little closer today.
